messages:
Sara: Akri Labs asking for 150k trial credits for a 6-week POC. Our starter is 30k. They say embeddings + retrieval will burn it. Can we approve?
Dean: What's the ARR potential? Are they in our startup program?
Sara: They're YC S22, likely > $500k ARR if POC converts. Not in our promo program yet. They've completed the SecQ (cc Bryan).
Maya: From infra POV we can limit spend and still show value. Suggest 75k upfront + gating, or telemetry hooks to meter.
Deal Desk: Need commercial rationale + a renewal/commit or milestone release schedule. Also require legal on data-use. @Bryan (DevSec) can you confirm SQ?
Bryan (DevSec): Confirmed — SQ passed except one S3 policy which they fixed. No outstanding infra concerns. They want client-side key management, acceptable.
Dean: Proposal: approve 75k free credits now + request a 3-month 10k/mo commit for access to dedicated instance and 20% discount. If they hit milestone (proto queries/day or quality), release remaining 75k.
Sara: Customer ok w/ gating. Who sign-off? AE + Deal Desk + Legal?
Deal Desk: I can pre-approve conditionally. I'll draft the milestone schedule and a short memo for Legal and CS. Need exec summary + usage projection.
Sara: Sent exec summary link: https://redwood.app/deals/akri-poc (internal). Key bullets pasted: YC S22, vector search at 1B embeddings, expects 200k queries/day in peak.
Maya: Engineering notes for the POC: enable prefix caching, KV retention 24h, and rate-limit token issuance. I'll spin dev creds with caps. Config snippet:
```
rate_limit: 60r/m
token_cap: 750000
notify: #eng-poc
```
Dean: @Deal Desk can you provide a signed memo template we can present to the customer for milestone release?
Deal Desk: Yep — will circulate a 1-pager by EOD and attach draft terms. :thumbsup: 
Sara: Great, thanks everyone. I'll wait for the memo and update after Legal reviews. Marking thread as in-flight.
